verdict.rationale: Runloop documents suspend/resume to "save state and costs" and Axons that let agents "suspend when idle, wake on demand," indicating some idle-triggered lifecycle management, but there is no explicit documentation of a developer-configurable timeout parameter that auto-shuts-down a Devbox and stops billing after inactivity or completion. missing for 10: explicit timeout/idle-shutdown configuration API or CLI flag, confirmation that suspension halts billing automatically without agent action.
